en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-65 Muhammad ibn al-Hassan - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Abdullah ibn Ja’far al-Homayry quoted Harun ibn Muslim, on the authority of Mus’adat ibn Sadaqah, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad (MGB), on the authority of his father (MGB) that

God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “Four acts will make the heart perish: committing sins continuously; talking with women often; arguing with a fool, (since you keep talking with him, but he will never be guided to the right way), and associating with the dead!” They asked him what he meant by the dead? The Prophet of God (MGB) said, “All the rich who live in ease and luxury.”
